A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same work, including corresponding figures, Table 1, and Appendices A–C. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection reveal no material gaps.

before.justification: v2 reports original DAE experiments, memorization-detection measurements in Table 1, image-editing demonstrations, and robustness and Jacobian analyses in the appendices.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experiments and results, including the detection measurements, image-editing examples, and appendix analyses.

M1.justification: The ReLU DAE architecture and objective, representation-STD detector, and additive steering rule remain unchanged. Appendix B.3 corrects an implementation layer identifier without introducing a revised algorithm.

E1.justification: Both retain synthetic MoG and CelebA studies, LAION/ImageNet/CIFAR10 evaluations, and the same generation, detection, image-editing, and appendix test scenarios.

E2.justification: Table 1 retains Carlini et al. (2023), Wen et al. (2024), and Hintersdorf et al. (2024) for LAION, and Ross et al. (2025) for all three datasets. No evaluated comparator membership changes.

E3.justification: Appendix B.3 changes the sixth listed image-editing feature layer from up_blocks.0.resnets.2, duplicated in v2, to up_blocks.1.resnets.2. This revises the reported configuration; the PDFs do not establish that experiments were rerun. Other settings remain unchanged.

E4.justification: The noise, separability, optimizer, and encoder-decoder tying checks, test-image denoising, Jacobian analysis, duplication experiment, and single-layer and SD3.5 steering analyses are retained without substantive changes.

E5.justification: Appendix A.1 retains the same qualitative random-seed discussion. No repeated-run counts, confidence intervals, significance tests, or other uncertainty-reporting practices are added or revised.

E6.justification: Table 1 is identical, including the proposed detector's AUROCs of 0.987, 0.995, and 0.998 on LAION, ImageNet, and CIFAR10. The experimental plots and editing examples retain their results; Figure 7 preserves its images and numerical annotations despite restyling.

T1.justification: Corollary 3.3 changes the population-denoiser factor from (S_k + σI)^(-1) to (S_k + σ²I)^(-1). This corrects its noise dependence to match Equation 8 and the expression already present in Appendix C.5 of v2. Assumptions and proof arguments otherwise remain unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, contributions, and discussion retain the same representation-based account of memorization and generalization and the same detection and steering contributions.

C2.justification: Explanations linking spiky and balanced representations to generation and steering remain unchanged, as do the qualifications concerning the simplified theoretical setting and the appendix discussion of SD3.5 steering difficulties.

D1.justification: The corrected layer identifier in Appendix B.3 resolves a duplicate in the stated six-layer implementation. Remaining training, sampling, detection, and editing details and code/project access links are unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to earlier theoretical models, memorization detectors, and representation-learning research are unchanged.

P1.justification: Limited edits update dates and funding identifiers and capitalize the Figure 6 caption. Appendix C.3 and its contents entry change 'Proof of Corollary 3.2' to 'Proof of Theorem 3.2,' although the statement remains labeled a corollary. Document organization is unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 7 receive color-grouping, sizing, and spacing changes. Figure 7 replaces its uniform green background with separate colored highlighting while retaining the same evidence. No figures or tables are added or removed.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves mathematical consistency and reproducibility by correcting Corollary 3.3's noise-variance term and Appendix B.3's duplicated layer identifier. These concrete fixes outweigh the small editorial regression from calling Corollary 3.2 a theorem in the C.3 heading. Empirical support and the paper's substantive scope remain unchanged.
